```{r}
customSummary <- function(data, lev = NULL, model = NULL) {
  confusion <- confusionMatrix(data$pred, data$obs, positive = "positive")
  sens <- unname(confusion$byClass["Sensitivity"])
  spec <- unname(confusion$byClass["Specificity"])
  ppv  <- unname(confusion$byClass["Pos Pred Value"])
  npv  <- unname(confusion$byClass["Neg Pred Value"])
  f1_score <- 2 * ((ppv * sens) / (ppv + sens))
  roc_auc <- tryCatch(
    pROC::auc(pROC::roc(data$obs, data$positive, quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")),
    error = function(e) return(0.5))
  out <- c(
    ROC = roc_auc, F1 = f1_score,
    Accuracy = confusion$overall["Accuracy"],
    Kappa = confusion$overall["Kappa"],
    Sens = sens, Spec = spec, PPV = ppv, NPV = npv)
  return(out)
}

generate_ci <- function(pred, threshold, alpha = 0.05) {
  pred <- pred %>% dplyr::mutate(pred = case_when(
    positive >= threshold ~ "positive",
    TRUE ~ "negative"
  ))
  pred$pred <- as.factor(pred$pred)

  dat <- data.frame(
    pred %>%
      group_by(Resample) %>%
      group_modify(~ as.data.frame(t(customSummary(.x)))) %>%
      ungroup()
  )

  generate_ci_fun <- function(x) {
    if (!is.numeric(x)) return(c(NA, NA))
    lower <- quantile(x, probs = alpha / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
    upper <- quantile(x, probs = 1 - alpha / 2, na.rm = TRUE)
    ci <- c(lower, upper); names(ci) <- c("2.5%", "97.5%"); return(ci)
  }

  ci_results <- sapply(dat, generate_ci_fun)
  return(as.data.frame(ci_results))
}
```

```{r}
base_genus <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    stringr::str_remove("_(g|s)_(cpn60|16s)$") %>%   # raw taxa features
    stringr::str_remove("^(lacto|crisp)_vs_") %>%     # ratio numerator prefix
    stringr::str_remove("_(cpn60|16s)$")              # trailing marker suffix
}

base_key <- function(feat) {
  if (stringr::str_detect(feat, "^alpha_diversity")) return(feat)
  if (stringr::str_detect(feat, "^(lacto|crisp)_x_")) {
    return(stringr::str_remove(feat, "_(cpn60|16s)$"))
  }
  if (stringr::str_detect(feat, "_(cpn60|16s)$")) return(base_genus(feat))
  feat
}

strip_caret_suffix <- function(feats, valid_names) {
  vapply(feats, function(f) {
    if (f %in% valid_names) return(f)          
    f2 <- sub("1$", "", f)                      
    if (f2 %in% valid_names) f2 else f          
  }, character(1), USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
my_tax_aggregate <- function(phylo_obj, rank, top_n) {
  phylo_obj_agg <- phylo_obj %>%
    tax_fix(unknowns = c("Clostridiales_bacterium")) %>%
    tax_transform("identity", rank = rank)
  tax <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phylo_obj_agg))
  rownames(tax) <- taxa_names(phylo_obj_agg)
  taxa_names(phylo_obj_agg) <- as.character(tax[, rank])
  phylo_obj_agg_RA <- transform_sample_counts(phylo_obj_agg, function(x) x / sum(x))
  ra_table  <- otu_table(phylo_obj_agg_RA)
  raw_table <- otu_table(phylo_obj_agg)
  if (taxa_are_rows(phylo_obj_agg_RA)) {
    ra_table  <- t(ra_table)
    raw_table <- t(raw_table)
  }
  mean_rel_abund   <- colMeans(ra_table)
  top_n_taxa_names <- names(sort(mean_rel_abund, decreasing = TRUE))[1:top_n]
  abund_top_n      <- raw_table[, top_n_taxa_names]
  abund_other      <- rowSums(raw_table[, !(colnames(raw_table) %in% top_n_taxa_names)])
  abund_final      <- as.data.frame(abund_top_n)
  abund_final$Other <- abund_other
  abund_final$ID    <- rownames(abund_final)
  return(abund_final)
}

clr_transform <- function(x) {
  log_x <- log(x)
  gmean_log <- mean(log_x)
  return(log_x - gmean_log)
}

clr_transform_comp <- function(data) {
  data_ra  <- data + 0.001
  data_ra  <- t(apply(data_ra, 1, function(x) x / sum(x)))
  data_clr <- apply(data_ra, 1, clr_transform)
  return(data_clr)
}
```

```{r}
clr_df <- function(raw_df, suffix) {
  ids <- raw_df$ID
  mat <- raw_df %>% select(-ID, -Other) %>% as.matrix()
  clr <- data.frame(t(clr_transform_comp(as.data.frame(mat))))
  clr$ID <- ids
  clr <- janitor::clean_names(clr)
  clr <- clr %>% rename_with(~ paste0(., suffix), -id)
  return(clr)
}

n_genus_cpn60   <- ntaxa(tax_glom(filtered_cpn60, "genus"))
n_species_cpn60 <- ntaxa(tax_glom(filtered_cpn60, "species"))
n_genus_16s     <- ntaxa(tax_glom(filtered_16s,   "genus"))
n_species_16s   <- ntaxa(tax_glom(filtered_16s,   "species"))

genus_raw_cpn60_all   <- my_tax_aggregate(filtered_cpn60, rank = "genus",   top_n = n_genus_cpn60)
species_raw_cpn60_all <- my_tax_aggregate(filtered_cpn60, rank = "species", top_n = n_species_cpn60)
genus_raw_16s_all     <- my_tax_aggregate(filtered_16s,   rank = "genus",   top_n = n_genus_16s)
species_raw_16s_all   <- my_tax_aggregate(filtered_16s,   rank = "species", top_n = n_species_16s)

genus_clr_cpn60   <- clr_df(genus_raw_cpn60_all,   suffix = "_g_cpn60")
species_clr_cpn60 <- clr_df(species_raw_cpn60_all, suffix = "_s_cpn60")
genus_clr_16s     <- clr_df(genus_raw_16s_all,     suffix = "_g_16s")
species_clr_16s   <- clr_df(species_raw_16s_all,   suffix = "_s_16s")
```

```{r}
to_ra <- function(raw_df) {
  ids <- raw_df$ID
  mat <- raw_df %>% select(-ID) %>% as.matrix()
  ra  <- mat / rowSums(mat)
  data.frame(ra, ID = ids)
}

# cpn60 ratios
ra_genus_cpn60   <- to_ra(genus_raw_cpn60_all)
ra_species_cpn60 <- to_ra(species_raw_cpn60_all)

lacto_cpn60 <- ra_genus_cpn60$Lactobacillus
crisp_cpn60 <- ra_species_cpn60$Lactobacillus.crispatus
other_genera_cpn60 <- ra_genus_cpn60 %>% select(-ID, -Lactobacillus, -Other)

ratios_cpn60 <- map_dfc(colnames(other_genera_cpn60), function(tax) {
  denom <- other_genera_cpn60[[tax]] + 1e-6
  tibble(
    "lacto_vs_{tax}_cpn60" := lacto_cpn60 / denom,
    "crisp_vs_{tax}_cpn60" := crisp_cpn60 / denom
  )
})
ratios_cpn60$ID <- ra_genus_cpn60$ID

# 16S ratios
ra_genus_16s   <- to_ra(genus_raw_16s_all)
ra_species_16s <- to_ra(species_raw_16s_all)

lacto_16s <- ra_genus_16s$Lactobacillus
crisp_16s <- ra_species_16s$Lactobacillus_crispatus
other_genera_16s <- ra_genus_16s %>% select(-ID, -Lactobacillus, -Other)

ratios_16s <- map_dfc(colnames(other_genera_16s), function(tax) {
  denom <- other_genera_16s[[tax]] + 1e-6
  tibble(
    "lacto_vs_{tax}_16s" := lacto_16s / denom,
    "crisp_vs_{tax}_16s" := crisp_16s / denom
  )
})
ratios_16s$ID <- ra_genus_16s$ID

ratios_cpn60 <- janitor::clean_names(ratios_cpn60) %>% rename(id = id)
ratios_16s   <- janitor::clean_names(ratios_16s)   %>% rename(id = id)
```

```{r}
ec_raw <- read.table(

  header = TRUE, sep = "\t", row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE
)

ko_t <- as.data.frame(t(ko_raw))
ec_t <- as.data.frame(t(ec_raw))

clr_transform_picrust <- function(mat) {
  mat     <- mat + 1e-6
  mat     <- mat / rowSums(mat)
  log_mat <- log(mat)
  gm      <- rowMeans(log_mat)
  sweep(log_mat, 1, gm, "-")
}

ko_clr <- as.data.frame(clr_transform_picrust(ko_t)); ko_clr$id <- rownames(ko_clr)
ec_clr <- as.data.frame(clr_transform_picrust(ec_t)); ec_clr$id <- rownames(ec_clr)

ec_clr <- janitor::clean_names(ec_clr) %>% rename_with(~ paste0(., "_ec"), -id)
```

```{r}


set.seed(2025)
outcome_var      <- "pct"
all_features_exp <- setdiff(names(full_feature_df), outcome_var)
y_full           <- full_feature_df$pct

TOP_N   <- 20    
K_FOLDS <- 5
N_REPS  <- 20

cv_folds <- createMultiFolds(y_full, k = K_FOLDS, times = N_REPS)

fold_selected_features <- vector("list", length(cv_folds))
fold_metrics           <- vector("list", length(cv_folds))

for (i in seq_along(cv_folds)) {
  cat("Fold", i, "of", length(cv_folds), "\n")

  train_idx <- cv_folds[[i]]
  test_idx  <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(full_feature_df)), train_idx)

  train_df  <- full_feature_df[train_idx, ]
  test_df   <- full_feature_df[test_idx, ]

  train_smote <- upSample(
    x     = train_df %>% select(-pct),
    y     = train_df$pct,
    yname = "pct"
  )

  X_train_s <- train_smote %>% select(-pct)
  y_train_s <- train_smote$pct

  # Step 1: tune RF on ALL features in train fold
  fold_ctrl_tune <- trainControl(
    method          = "cv",
    number          = 3,
    classProbs      = TRUE,
    summaryFunction = customSummary,
    sampling        = NULL
  )

  rf_tune_grid_fold <- expand.grid(
    mtry          = seq(1, 100, 20),
    splitrule     = "gini",
    min.node.size = c(1, 5, 10)
  )

  fold_rf_all <- train(
    x          = X_train_s,
    y          = y_train_s,
    method     = "ranger",
    metric     = "F1",
    trControl  = fold_ctrl_tune,
    importance = "permutation",
    tuneGrid   = rf_tune_grid_fold
  )

  imp <- varImp(fold_rf_all, scale = TRUE)$importance
  imp$Feature <- rownames(imp)

  ranked <- imp %>%
    arrange(desc(Overall)) %>%
    pull(Feature)
  ranked <- strip_caret_suffix(ranked, colnames(X_train_s))

  top_features <- character(0)
  seen_keys    <- character(0)

  for (f in ranked) {
    key <- base_key(f)
    if (key %in% seen_keys) next          
    top_features <- c(top_features, f)
    seen_keys    <- c(seen_keys, key)
    if (length(top_features) == TOP_N) break
  }

  fold_selected_features[[i]] <- top_features

  .k <- vapply(top_features, base_key, character(1))
  if (any(duplicated(.k))) {
    cat("duplicate key in fold", i, ":",
        paste(top_features[.k %in% .k[duplicated(.k)]], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }

  # Step 3: refit RF on selected complementary features only
  top_in_train <- intersect(top_features, colnames(X_train_s))
  rf_tune_grid_top <- expand.grid(
    mtry          = seq(1, max(1, length(top_in_train)), by = 1),
    splitrule     = "gini",
    min.node.size = c(1, 5, 10)
  )

  fold_rf_top <- train(
    x         = X_train_s[, top_in_train],
    y         = y_train_s,
    method    = "ranger",
    metric    = "F1",
    trControl = fold_ctrl_tune,
    tuneGrid  = rf_tune_grid_top
  )

  # Step 4: evaluate on held-out test fold
  top_in_test <- intersect(top_in_train, colnames(test_df))
  probs <- predict(fold_rf_top,
                   newdata = test_df[, top_in_test],
                   type    = "prob")[, "positive"]
  preds <- factor(ifelse(probs > 0.5, "positive", "negative"),
                  levels = c("negative", "positive"))

  cm  <- confusionMatrix(preds, test_df$pct, positive = "positive")
  auc <- tryCatch(
    as.numeric(pROC::auc(pROC::roc(test_df$pct, probs,
                                   quiet = TRUE, direction = "<"))),
    error = function(e) NA
  )

  fold_metrics[[i]] <- data.frame(
    fold  = i,
    AUROC = auc,
    Sens  = unname(cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]),
    Spec  = unname(cm$byClass["Specificity"]),
    PPV   = unname(cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]),
    NPV   = unname(cm$byClass["Neg Pred Value"])
  )
}

cat("CV loop complete\n")


bad_names <- setdiff(unlist(fold_selected_features), names(full_feature_df))
if (length(bad_names) > 0) {
  cat("Selected names not found in full_feature_df:\n"); print(bad_names)
} else {
  cat("All selected feature names map to real columns\n")
}
```

```{r}
# ── Stability analysis (marker-level) ────────────────────────────────────────
all_selected  <- unlist(fold_selected_features)
n_folds_total <- length(cv_folds)
STABILITY_THRESHOLD <- 0.20  # selected in ≥20% of folds

selection_df <- data.frame(
  Feature    = names(sort(table(all_selected), decreasing = TRUE)),
  Count      = as.numeric(sort(table(all_selected), decreasing = TRUE)),
  Proportion = as.numeric(sort(table(all_selected), decreasing = TRUE)) / n_folds_total
)


selection_df <- selection_df %>%
  mutate(key = vapply(as.character(Feature), base_key, character(1)))

winners <- selection_df %>%
  group_by(key) %>%
  slice_max(Count, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(Count))

stable_features <- winners %>%
  filter(Proportion >= STABILITY_THRESHOLD) %>%
  pull(Feature)


cat("\nStable features (one per genus, ≥", STABILITY_THRESHOLD * 100, "% of folds):\n", sep = "")
print(stable_features)
cat("N stable features:", length(stable_features), "\n")

cat("\nCompeting forms per surviving genus:\n")
selection_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(key %in% vapply(stable_features, base_key, character(1))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(key, dplyr::desc(Count)) %>%
  dplyr::select(key, Feature, Count, Proportion) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  print(n = Inf)

selection_df %>%
  slice_head(n = 40) %>%
  mutate(
    stable  = Proportion >= STABILITY_THRESHOLD,
    marker  = str_extract(Feature, "(cpn60|16s)$")
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Proportion,
             y = reorder(Feature, Proportion),
             fill = stable)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_point(aes(shape = marker), x = -0.005, size = 1.5, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("cpn60" = 16, "16s" = 17),
                     na.translate = FALSE, name = "Marker") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#CCCCCC", "TRUE" = "#7F77DD"),
                    labels = c("Below threshold", "Stable (≥20%)"),
                    name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Selection frequency across CV folds", y = NULL,
       title = "Feature stability — complementary marker selection") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
# ── STAGE 2: Refit on stable features with proper repeated CV ────────────────
if (length(stable_features) == 0) {
  warning("No features passed ", STABILITY_THRESHOLD*100,
          "% threshold — lower threshold or increase TOP_N")
}

stable_features_formula <- as.formula(
  paste("pct ~", paste(stable_features, collapse = " + "))
)

rf_tune_grid_stable <- expand.grid(
  mtry          = seq(1, length(stable_features), by = 1),
  splitrule     = "gini",
  min.node.size = seq(1, 20, by = 2)
)

model_cv_control_stable <- trainControl(
  method          = "repeatedcv",
  number          = 5,
  repeats         = 20,
  classProbs      = TRUE,
  summaryFunction = customSummary,
  savePredictions = "final",
  sampling        = "smote",
  allowParallel   = TRUE
)

set.seed(2025)
final_model_stable <- train(
  stable_features_formula,
  data      = full_feature_df,
  method    = "ranger",
  metric    = "F1",
  trControl = model_cv_control_stable,
  tuneGrid  = rf_tune_grid_stable,
  importance = "permutation" 
)

best <- final_model_stable$bestTune

final_metrics_stable <- final_model_stable$results %>%
  filter(
    mtry          == best$mtry,
    splitrule     == best$splitrule,
    min.node.size == best$min.node.size
  ) %>%
  select(ROC, F1, Sens, Spec, PPV, NPV) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ round(., 3)))

print(final_metrics_stable)

generate_ci(final_model_stable$pred, 0.5)
```

```{r}
# ── Threshold optimization (closest to (0,1) corner) ─────────────────────────
cv_predictions <- final_model_stable$pred

cv_data <- cv_predictions %>%
  dplyr::select(obs, positive) %>%
  mutate(obs = factor(obs, levels = c("negative", "positive")))

thresholds <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)

calculate_distance <- function(thresh) {
  predicted_class <- factor(
    ifelse(cv_data$positive > thresh, "positive", "negative"),
    levels = c("negative", "positive")
  )
  cm <- confusionMatrix(predicted_class, cv_data$obs, positive = "positive")
  sens <- cm$byClass["Sensitivity"]
  spec <- cm$byClass["Specificity"]
  ppv  <- cm$byClass["Pos Pred Value"]
  npv  <- cm$byClass["Neg Pred Value"]
  f1   <- 2 * ((ppv * sens) / (ppv + sens))
  TPR  <- sens
  FPR  <- 1 - spec
  distance <- sqrt(FPR^2 + (TPR - 1)^2)
  roc_auc <- tryCatch(
    pROC::auc(pROC::roc(cv_data$obs, cv_data$positive,
                        quiet = TRUE, direction = "<")),
    error = function(e) return(0.5))
  data.frame(
    Threshold = thresh, F1 = f1, ROC = roc_auc, Distance = distance,
    Sensitivity = TPR, Specificity = spec, FPR = FPR, PPV = ppv, NPV = npv
  )
}

distance_results <- do.call(rbind, lapply(thresholds, calculate_distance))
optimal_threshold_row <- distance_results %>% arrange(Distance) %>% head(1)

cat("\n========================================================\n")
cat("      FINAL MODEL METRICS (Closest to (0, 1) Corner)\n")
cat("========================================================\n")
cat(paste("Optimal threshold:", round(optimal_threshold_row$Threshold, 3), "\n"))
cat(paste("Euclidean distance:", round(optimal_threshold_row$Distance, 3), "\n"))
cat("--------------------------------------------------------\n")

final_metrics_distance <- optimal_threshold_row %>%
  dplyr::select(Threshold, Distance, F1, ROC, Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, NPV) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))

print("Metrics at optimal threshold:")
print(final_metrics_distance)
final_metrics_distance <- optimal_threshold_row %>%
  dplyr::select(Threshold, Distance, F1, ROC, Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, NPV) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 3)))

print("Metrics at optimal threshold:")
ci_tbl <- generate_ci(final_model_stable$pred, optimal_threshold_row$Threshold)
lo <- ci_tbl[1, ]   # 2.5%
hi <- ci_tbl[2, ]   # 97.5%

fmt <- function(est, l, h) sprintf("%.2f [%.2f, %.2f]", est, l, h)

summary_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  Metric = c("AUROC", "NPV", "Sensitivity", "PPV", "Specificity"),
  Value  = c(
    fmt(final_metrics_distance$ROC,         lo[["ROC"]],  hi[["ROC"]]),
    fmt(final_metrics_distance$NPV,         lo[["NPV"]],  hi[["NPV"]]),
    fmt(final_metrics_distance$Sensitivity, lo[["Sens"]], hi[["Sens"]]),
    fmt(final_metrics_distance$PPV,         lo[["PPV"]],  hi[["PPV"]]),
    fmt(final_metrics_distance$Specificity, lo[["Spec"]], hi[["Spec"]])
  )
)
print(summary_tbl, n = Inf)
```

```{r}
# ── SHAP interpretation ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pred_fun <- function(model, newdata) {
  as.numeric(predict(model, newdata = newdata, type = "prob")[, "positive"])
}

set.seed(42)
bg_sample <- full_feature_df[
  sample(nrow(full_feature_df), min(nrow(full_feature_df), 50)), , drop = FALSE
]

data_df_scaled <- full_feature_df %>% dplyr::select(all_of(stable_features))

shap_results <- kernelshap(
  object   = final_model_stable,
  X        = data_df_scaled,
  bg_X     = bg_sample,
  pred_fun = pred_fun
)

sv <- shapviz(shap_results)

shap_plot <- sv_importance(
  sv,
  kind        = "beeswarm",
  max_display = length(stable_features)
) +
  ggtitle("SHAP feature importance") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 15)
  )


rf_imp_df <- varImp(final_model_stable, scale = FALSE)$importance %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Feature") %>%
  dplyr::rename(Importance = Overall) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(Importance))

rf_plot <- ggplot(rf_imp_df,
                  aes(x = Importance, y = reorder(Feature, Importance))) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = Importance,
                   yend = reorder(Feature, Importance)),
               color = "#187ac5ff", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(color = "#187ac5ff", size = 3) +
  labs(x = "Permutation importance", y = NULL,
       title = "Random forest permutation importance") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title   = element_text(size = 15)
  )


combined <- shap_plot + rf_plot + plot_layout(ncol = 2)
ggsave("complementary_species_imp.pdf",
       combined, width = 14, height = 6)
```

```{r}
cv_predictions <- final_model_stable$pred %>%
  mutate(
    pred_class = factor(
      ifelse(positive >= optimal_threshold_row$Threshold, "positive", "negative"),
      levels = c("negative", "positive")
    ),
    correct       = pred_class == obs,
    misclassified = pred_class != obs,
    error_type    = case_when(
      obs == "positive" & pred_class == "negative" ~ "False Negative",
      obs == "negative" & pred_class == "positive" ~ "False Positive",
      TRUE                                          ~ "Correct"
    )
  )

sample_error_summary <- cv_predictions %>%
  group_by(rowIndex) %>%
  summarise(
    n_folds            = n(),
    n_correct          = sum(correct),
    n_misclassified    = sum(misclassified),
    pct_misclassified  = round(mean(misclassified) * 100, 1),
    true_label         = first(obs),
    n_false_neg        = sum(error_type == "False Negative"),
    n_false_pos        = sum(error_type == "False Positive"),
    mean_prob_positive = round(mean(positive), 3),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_misclassified))

labels_df <- read.csv("lacto_domin.csv")
colnames(labels_df) <- c("ID", "m_16S", "m_cpn60")

sample_error_summary <- sample_error_summary %>%
  mutate(ID = rownames(full_feature_df)[rowIndex])

misclass_annotated <- sample_error_summary %>%
  left_join(labels_df, by = "ID") %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_misclassified))

misclass_annotated %>%
  filter(pct_misclassified > 0) %>%
  select(ID, true_label, pct_misclassified,
         n_false_neg, n_false_pos, mean_prob_positive) %>%
  print(n = Inf)

misclass_plot <- misclass_annotated %>%
  filter(pct_misclassified > 0) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = factor(ID, levels = ID[order(pct_misclassified)]),
    lacto_16s = case_when(
      m_16S == "yes"     ~ "Dominant",
      m_16S == "maybe"   ~ "Maybe",
      m_16S == "missing" ~ "Missing",
      TRUE               ~ "Not dominant"
    ),
    lacto_cpn60 = case_when(
      m_cpn60 == "yes" ~ "Dominant",
      TRUE             ~ "Not dominant"
    )
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c(lacto_16s, lacto_cpn60),
    names_to  = "marker_gene",
    values_to = "lacto_status"
  ) %>%
  mutate(marker_gene = case_when(
    marker_gene == "lacto_16s"   ~ "16S",
    marker_gene == "lacto_cpn60" ~ "cpn60"
  )) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = pct_misclassified, y = ID, fill = lacto_status)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Dominant" = "#2ECC71", "Maybe" = "#F39C12",
               "Not dominant" = "#E74C3C", "Missing" = "#AAAAAA"),
    name = "Lactobacillus dominance"
  ) +
  facet_grid(true_label ~ marker_gene, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "% folds misclassified", y = NULL,
       title = "Misclassification rate by Lactobacillus dominance") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

ggsave("complementary_species_miscl.pdf",
       misclass_plot, width = 10, height = 6)
```
